dimensions.summary: Incremental planning and proposed-change overlays preserve one canonical generation and bind predictions to base generation digests.
Merkle comparison, shard reuse and overlay planning each declare independent bounded budgets.
Unequal Merkle branches and exact-digest shard reuse avoid whole-generation rescans in planning paths.
Overlay construction fails closed on base/proposal digest mismatch and rejects unauthorized shard reuse.
Overlay release claims prohibit latest advancement and merge-conflict authority over predicted state.
Local checks pass; retained same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G6 evidence remains required.
Incremental and overlay APIs remain outside the root export surface and do not import central CLI runtime.
Comparison, shard reuse, incremental planning and overlay prediction preserve stable ordering and honest accounting.
ChangeSet, GraphDelta, ContentStateManifest and overlay wire contracts are versioned candidates in the catalog.
Overlay staleness and partial budget truncation report explicit diagnostics without empty success.
G6 checkpoints have dedicated contract, application, pipeline and governance coverage.
The package remains private and packed output excludes source, tests, governance, scripts, maps and internal documents.

checks.evidence: Package-owned build, contract, test, runtime, packed-consumer and admission gates pass locally.
All G6 stage-plan checkpoints except g6-cross-platform-admission are implemented-local-candidate.
Same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G6 admission evidence is not yet retained.

remainingRisks: The signed candidate still requires retained Linux, Windows and macOS G6 evidence.
Selective provider recomputation and equivalence assessment are implemented locally; retained cross-platform admission evidence is still required before registry advance.
Proposed overlays predict invalidation only; observed fact identifiers require a subsequent canonical rebuild.
Rust, native and WASM acceleration remain prohibited until benchmark evidence justifies a parity-checked adapter.
Central CLI shadow parity and replacement remain prohibited until G8.

approval.rule: A signed checkpoint plus retained same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS G6 evidence authorizes G7 only.
